description: Look up the mcpgrade security grade (A–F) for a specific MCP server by name. Use this before installing or trusting an MCP server. Returns the grade, 0–100 score, publisher, and a link to the full report with per-check findings.

name.description: Server name or id, e.g. 'com.stripe/mcp' or 'stripe'. Partial names are matched.

name: check_mcp_server
